headline: How to reach Sunreach in Palworld 1.0
title: How to Reach Sunreach in Palworld | Feybreak Tower Portal | Palworld Guide
video_script: Wondering how to get to Sunreach, the sky islands of Palworld one point zero? Head to the Feybreak Tower at the southern edge of Feybreak Island. Beat the tower boss fight, Bjorn and Bastigor. Bastigor is Ice, so bring Fire Pals. After you win, step through the portal on top of the tower, and you'll drop into the Sunreach sky islands. It's a high level area, so level up before you go. Made it to Sunreach yet? Comment below!
description: How to reach Sunreach in Palworld 1.0: go to the Feybreak Tower at the southern edge of Feybreak Island, beat Bjorn and Bastigor, then take the portal on top of the tower into the Sunreach sky islands.
